arbiter: Hand-derived integer interval membership and rule states from composition-windows.json, no ephemeris
derivation: Cut the chronological composition cells at 25, 50 and 75. Equal states touch across 25 and 75 and retain their id. The hard unknown gap [40,50) prevents joining [30,40) to [50,60), even though their preference states match. Every label belongs to at most one chunk; the final endpoint 100 belongs to none. No score or global rank is emitted by default.
